divergences.summary: Keep the accepted virtual user document, explicit Save, readonly/disposal fences and sandboxed capability clients. Per-file rationale identifies retained symbols and non-mechanical adaptations; generic source contracts retained for dependency compatibility do not activate those products.

verification.obligation: Verify every exact pinned source blob. Adapted file rationale and explicit exclusions own source-to-local differences; this check alone does not establish behavior.
